case: restore — an archive stamped with the current axes
why: The second vacuity control. Archive invalidation that invalidated everything would silently disable Go-Explore's persistence entirely, so the suite proves a matching archive restores.

archive.note: A Go-Explore archive entry. TBP's save_checkpoint response carries {id, tier, frame, latency_ms, bytes, level} and no version field, so these axes are stamped by the adapter alongside the id.
